name: Andrzej Halicki, Matjaž Nemec - Avant le § 1 - Am 45
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2026
part_text: -1c. Calls, further, for the budget’s redistributive function to be stepped up, providing support for efforts to achieve real convergence in economic and social progress between Member States;
